method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Wall Street indexes dip with technology earnings, rising oil in focus
Equities.reason: Broad US equity-moving headline: tech earnings cycle and rising oil creating risk-off pressure. Represents market-regime narrative (earnings/costs + energy shock) so given elevated relevance.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall as AI Spending Fears Grow, Oil Rises: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: High-impact summary tying together the dominant market narratives — accelerating AI capex worries and energy/geopolitical-driven oil spike — producing materially negative equity sentiment; given centrality to market direction, assigned strong negative direction and high relevance.

Equities.title: Stock Market Today: Oil Prices Jump After Houthis Claim Attacks on Red Sea Tankers
Equities.reason: Geopolitical shock to energy shipping lanes pushing oil higher and weighing on broad risk appetite — clear negative for equities, treated as an important but specific risk factor.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Slumps for Fourth Time in Five Days as Oil Prices Jump
Equities.reason: Market breadth/flow signal: repeated S&P weakness tied to oil spike and earnings jitters — reinforces negative short-term market regime, moderate-high relevance.

Equities.title: Alphabet and Tesla test Wall Street's patience as AI spending overshadows growth
Equities.summary: Shares of Alphabet and Tesla dipped after the companies reported massive spending increases in their quarterly earnings reports.
Equities.reason: Large-cap leadership narrative: mega-cap AI spending is denting investor patience and weighing on market internals. Company-level but market-relevant due to concentration in indices, so moderately high relevance.

Equities.title: Tesla misses on earnings, as free cash flow turns negative and margins slide
Equities.summary: Tesla's earnings report lands in the midst of a slide in the company's stock price even as its core auto business is rebounding.
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic big-stock event with market-signalling power — negative for tech/market sentiment given Tesla's index weight and leadership role; relevance below pure macro but meaningful.

Equities.title: IBM lowers full-year forecast after earnings warning
Equities.summary: IBM is now looking to improve productivity with artificial intelligence, including with a new coding tool called Bob.
Equities.reason: Large-cap tech with guidance cut undermines the 'AI boosts productivity now' narrative; negative signal for cyclicals/tech but more company-specific so lower relevance.

Equities.title: Google beats quarterly revenue expectations off of enterprise AI surge
Equities.reason: Positive earnings/enterprise AI demand datapoint supporting earnings-side bullish case. Small positive counter-signal to capex concerns; low relevance because market reaction is dominated by spending worries.

Equities.title: Google burns through $6bn in cash as AI spending climbs again
Equities.summary: Search giant says it will commit up to $205bn to AI investments in 2026
Equities.reason: Major capex commitment by a mega-cap that feeds the dominant negative narrative (AI spending spooking investors and pressuring near-term earnings/profitability); high relevance given scale and market concentration.

Equities.title: Asian stocks rise as AI capex ramps up, oil at six-week highs
Equities.reason: Regional divergence — positive risk for Asia equities driven by AI capex momentum, though offset by commodity/geopolitical-driven oil strength. Captures cross-market nuance; moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Asian Chip Stocks Climb as Alphabet Spending Revives AI Momentum
Equities.reason: Direct sector-level positive: confirmed capital deployment into AI lifts chip demand and regional semiconductor names — clear supportive narrative for tech/capex beneficiaries with material relevance.

Equities.title: Indian shares likely to fall as oil surge dents sentiment
Equities.reason: Country-specific equity impact from higher oil and risk-off — negative for a major emerging market equity benchmark; included as a clear example of oil-driven local market pressure.

Equities.title: Wall Street Banks Trading Parts of $35 Billion AI Chip Deal
Equities.reason: Flow/funding signal: large institutional deal activity into AI/chips supports the pro-AI investment narrative and could underwrite sector strength; relevant but more transactional than market-wide.

Rates.title: What Surging Bond Yields Mean for Consumers and Markets
Rates.reason: Headline points to a broad rise in bond yields. In the 1XW rates framework higher yields = bond selloff/negative for rates; this is a broad-market, macro-relevant narrative affecting consumers, borrowing costs and financial conditions, so high relevance.

Rates.title: China Bond Rally Shows Weak Economic Sentiment Before Politburo
Rates.reason: Article signals a bond rally in China (yields falling) driven by weak economic sentiment ahead of a major political meeting — positive for bond prices in the region and relevant for global rates sentiment; moderately high relevance due to policy/Politburo timing.

Rates.title: The Treasury market touches a worrying milestone not seen since 2007
Rates.reason: Headline implies stress / adverse move in US Treasuries (higher yields or market dysfunction). Directly relevant to rates and market functioning; meaningful but not fully exceptional in isolation, hence moderate negative score.

Rates.title: Australian Employment Soars in June, Bolstering Rate-Hike Bets
Rates.reason: Stronger employment raises odds of further rate hikes in Australia, which lifts local yields and contributes to global hawkish sentiment; therefore negative for bond prices with above-normal relevance for rates.

Rates.title: Japan awakes
Rates.summary: Why 1 per cent interest rates could shake everything up after a generation of deflation
Rates.reason: FT frames a structural shift in Japan toward materially higher policy rates (e.g. 1%). That represents a regime change for global fixed income and is strongly negative for bond prices; high relevance due to systemic implications.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.reason: Fed discount-rate meeting minutes are directly relevant to policy and short-term funding conditions. With policy leaning towards tighter settings, this is mildly negative for bond prices; relevance is material but limited by lack of a single clear shock in the headline.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Money Market Committee meeting – June 2026
Rates.summary: The Money Markets Committee is a forum for market participants and authorities to discuss the UK unsecured deposits and funding market and securities lending and repo markets.
Rates.reason: BoE Money Market Committee minutes address funding and repo conditions that directly affect short-term rates and liquidity. Slightly negative signal for bonds/funding given ongoing tightening/liquidity vigilance, but lower relevance than major policy releases.

Rates.title: Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises: lending conditions tightened
Rates.reason: ECB survey indicating tighter lending conditions suggests a transmission of tighter monetary policy and/or tougher credit conditions, which supports higher yields (negative for bond prices) in the euro area; moderately relevant for rates.

FX.title: European Central Bank set to hold interest rates amid cooling inflation and weaker growth
FX.summary: The European Central Bank (ECB) is expected to hold the interest rate on the main refinancing operations and the deposit facility steady at 2.4% and 2.25%, respectively. The decision will be announced on Thursday at 12:15 GMT.
FX.reason: ECB holding rates amid cooling inflation and weaker growth is a modest dovish signal for the euro vs USD (reduces rate differential upside). Central-bank policy headlines are market‑relevant for EUR/USD so relevance is elevated.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Reflects strength ahead of ECB’s policy decision
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) is up 0.15% at around 1.1430 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Thursday. The EUR/USD pair rises as the major currency outperforms its peers ahead of the European Central Bank’s (ECB) monetary policy announc
FX.reason: Short-term EUR/USD technical/price commentary showing EUR strength into the ECB call. This is price‑forecast/technical content so relevance is capped lower, direction reflects near-term EUR bias.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gains traction on rising oil prices as US-Iran war escalates
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair attracts some sellers to near 1.4060 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. A rise in crude oil prices provides some support to the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Geopolitical escalation has driven oil higher, which directly supports CAD vs USD given commodity linkage. This is a clear FX transmission (oil -> CAD) with above‑average market relevance.

FX.title: Euro: Hawkish ECB stance to limit downside against US Dollar – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects the ECB to leave rates unchanged but deliver a hawkish hold, with Middle East tensions and rising European gas prices keeping hawks in control.
FX.reason: Analyst view that a 'hawkish hold' will cap EUR downside vs USD. Institutional commentary on ECB tone is relevant to EUR outlook; raises the probability EUR outperformance vs a plain dovish hold.

FX.title: US-Iran tensions underpin dollar as yen nears 40-year low
FX.reason: Geopolitical risk (US‑Iran tensions) is supporting the USD and depressing safe‑haven JPY (USD/JPY at multi‑decade highs). This is a material macro driver with strong FX transmission, so relevance is high and direction signals USD strength (negative for non‑USD pairs).

FX.title: Indian Rupee attracts slight bids on RBI’s provisional support
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday on possible Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervention in spot and non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) markets to support the currency.
FX.reason: Potential RBI intervention to support INR is a direct FX policy action; it implies short‑term INR strength vs USD. Central‑bank intervention stories carry explicit FX transmission, hence meaningful relevance.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah steadies as traders weigh BI’s decision of holding rates
FX.summary: USD/IDR moves little after posting minor gains in the previous day, trading around 17,960 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The pair steadies as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) strengthens following Bank Indonesia's (BI) surprise decision to hold benchmark rates
FX.reason: Bank Indonesia's surprise hold is supporting IDR vs USD; this is EMFX central‑bank news with clear FX impact, so relevance is material though not systemic.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: RBA tone may turn hawkish – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur highlights a strong Australian labor market, with 76,000 jobs added and participation back near historic highs, prompting markets to raise the implied probability of an RBA hike to 30%.
FX.reason: Stronger Aussie labour data raising RBA hawkish bets supports AUD vs USD. Central‑bank expectations tied to domestic data are important FX drivers; relevance elevated accordingly.

FX.title: British Pound: Sterling to hand back gains – ING
FX.summary: ING analysts Chris Turner, Francesco Pesole and James Smith argue Sterling’s summer strength is driven by positioning, carry and possible M&A flows rather than UK fundamentals.
FX.reason: ING view that sterling strength is position/flow driven (not fundamentals) implies downside risk vs USD. Analyst macro view on GBP is relevant for positioning and near‑term FX flows.

Commodities.title: Oil: Middle East tensions raise supply risks – MUFG
Commodities.summary: Lloyd Chan at MUFG underscores escalating US–Iran tensions and threats to energy infrastructure and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation around Hormuz/Bab el-Mandeb raises oil supply risk premium -> bullish for crude. High relevance because it's direct, market-moving supply shock.

Commodities.title: Brent: Energy risk premium rises – RaboResearch
Commodities.summary: Rabobank strategist Michael Every warns that escalating conflict around Hormuz and the Red Sea could push Brent above its current USD 95.5 level and widen crack spreads further.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note explicitly puts an energy risk premium on Brent from regional conflict -> supportive for oil prices and refining margins; relevant to market pricing.

Commodities.title: Oil jumps to $98 after Houthis attack two Saudi Arabian tankers
Commodities.summary: Yemeni rebels say they used missiles and drones to target the vessels Encelia and Layla
Commodities.reason: Direct attacks on tankers in a key transit area materially raise near-term supply disruption risk -> strong positive impulse for oil; high relevance given immediacy and scale.

Commodities.title: Brent Crude Spikes in Late Trading After Red Sea Tanker Attack
Commodities.reason: Price action spike following tanker attacks underscores immediate market repricing of geopolitical premium -> high market-moving relevance for oil.

Commodities.title: Oil prices rise to six-week high as US-Iran tensions escalate
Commodities.reason: Reuters run of the market move links oil gains to US–Iran escalation; reinforces broad market narrative of tighter risk premium -> meaningful relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil surpasses $97 after tankers struck off Saudi Arabia, Trump escalates Iran threats
Commodities.summary: Oil prices rose after U.S. President Donald Trump threatened to bomb Iranian infrastructure in response to any attacks on ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: Political escalation and threats amplify the risk premium on oil; high relevance as it can sustain near-term upward pressure on prices.

Commodities.title: Petroleum markets responded to disruptions in the Middle East in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) were characterized by continued disruptions to international crude oil and petroleum product flows through the Strait of Hormuz, contributing to higher and more volatile crude oil prices through most of th
Commodities.reason: Official EIA summary confirming market disruptions through key chokepoints -> supports a broader supply-risk narrative and elevated price volatility for oil.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Reported inventory build is a supply-side bearish datapoint that offsets some geopolitical premium; moderate relevance as it's weekly fundamental data.

Commodities.title: Goldman Sachs forecasts $120 Brent crude oil by Q4 2026 amid global instability
Commodities.reason: Major bank forecast of a materially higher Brent target underscores market expectations of sustained premium from instability -> supportive but forecast-driven (analyst view).

Commodities.title: India Silver Imports Slump as New Licensing Disrupts Shipments
Commodities.reason: Disruption to India's silver imports reduces one source of physical demand -> modestly negative for silver prices; relevant given India's large role in physical market.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD stalls below $60 as US yields rally
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) is trading practically flat, a few cents below the $60.00 level on Thursday, with upside attempts capped as US Treasury yields jump to fresh highs.
Commodities.reason: Rising US yields and USD pressure cap upside for silver (rate-sensitive precious metal) -> negative short-term impact; relevance limited to market/flow effects.

Commodities.title: Gold weakens below $4,100 as inflation fears lift Fed hike bets and support USD
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts some sellers during the first half of the European session on Thursday and slides below the $4,100 mark, retreating further from an over two-week high touched the previous day.
Commodities.reason: Fed hike expectations and a stronger USD are headwinds for gold despite geopolitical tensions; direct USD/rate transmission makes this relevant.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Gain as Dip-Buying Counters Inflation Fears From War
Commodities.reason: Safe-haven buying related to the conflict is supporting gold, partially offsetting rate/FX headwinds; relevant as it shows demand-side support for bullion.

Commodities.title: John Paulson says we are in the early stages of a long-term bull market for gold
Commodities.summary: He said demand for bullion continues to broaden, led by central banks that have been adding to their reserves alongside growing private-sector interest.
Commodities.reason: Prominent investor view highlights structural demand (central banks/private) supporting gold long-term; relevant but opinion-based, so moderate weight.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin retreats from one-month high as oil tops $85, inflation concerns resurface
Crypto.reason: Macro-driven downside for bitcoin: rising oil and renewed inflation fears lift rates and weigh on risk assets. Relevant as an immediate negative sentiment driver for BTC.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin wilts as oil and rates rise. Clarity Act odds tumble to 38%
Crypto.reason: Combination of macro (rates/oil) selling pressure on BTC and lower odds for favorable legislative clarity increases regulatory uncertainty — meaningful negative for market-wide risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Tesla holds bitcoin treasury steady, reports $112M impairment loss
Crypto.reason: Corporate accounting impairment highlights mark-to-market pain but no change in holdings — small negative idiosyncratic signal for BTC sentiment.

Crypto.title: SEC's Peirce warns some DeFi vaults, onchain lending may fall under securities laws
Crypto.reason: Regulatory risk to DeFi protocols is explicit and material to token valuations and lending markets — clear negative for the DeFi segment and broader risk-off flows.

Crypto.title: Here's why bitcoin bulls should take a closer look at interest rates
Crypto.reason: The piece frames rates as a dominant driver for BTC prospects; serves as a cautionary macro signal that can amplify price volatility — modest negative tilt given current rate trajectory.

Crypto.title: SecondFi to shut down after $2.4 million ADA wallet theft
Crypto.reason: Protocol insolvency following a hack is a direct negative for on-chain confidence and ADA/DeFi ecosystem credibility — meaningful idiosyncratic downside.

Crypto.title: Clarity Act Mired In Debate Over Whether to Bar President From Selling Crypto
Crypto.reason: High-profile legislative debate injects political/regulatory uncertainty into the market; reduces clarity on future rules — negative for sentiment.

Crypto.title: Popular crypto firm files for Chapter 11 after token collapse
Crypto.reason: Bankruptcy following a token collapse is a material credit/contagion event for the sector and a substantive negative for market confidence and counterparty risk.

Crypto.title: South Korea's oldest crypto exchange is now part of the $1 trillion Mirae Group family
Crypto.reason: Strategic acquisition by a large financial group supports institutionalization and exchange-sector stability in a key market — modest positive for on‑shore exchange confidence.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum-linked protocols lose $35 million in multiple attacks hours apart
Crypto.reason: Large, clustered exploits across BTC/ETH-linked protocols are a major negative for market trust and risk assets — high relevance and clear downward pressure on risk sentiment.

Crypto.title: Senator Lummis: Ethics, other provisions in crypto Clarity Act to be further discussed
Crypto.reason: Ongoing negotiations could soften problematic provisions; marginally positive as a signal that lawmakers are iterating on legislation rather than finalizing punitive rules.

Crypto.title: Key Democratic lawmakers say crypto Clarity Act 'falls short' on ethics, other issues
Crypto.reason: Political pushback highlights contentiousness and potential for further amendments or delays — net negative as it prolongs regulatory uncertainty.

Crypto.title: New draft of Clarity Act is out, and it would impose limits on Trump's crypto empire
Crypto.reason: Draft shows targeted, politicized provisions that create legal/regulatory complexity; modest negative for near-term legislative clarity.

Crypto.title: Balance stablecoin collapses 99% after $1 million exploit drains its bitcoin vaults
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin failure is an acute systemic confidence event for crypto cash-equivalents; extremely high relevance and a severe negative for short‑term market trust and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Forget Nvidia: The next big AI trade could be crypto and blockchain
Crypto.reason: Narrative of AI adoption as a positive demand catalyst for crypto/blockchain assets is constructive for medium-term investor interest and flows.
